application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: T1 - Extra-large Horse Chestnut ,TPO. Lift canopy to 12m by removing all epicormic growth.T2 - Dead medium size Hornbeam to rear right hand side of garden. Section fell to groundlevel.T3 - Dead small apple tree. Section fell to ground level.T4 - Medium Horse Chestnuts in rear left-hand side of garden. Remove dead wood. Notetree is in significant decline.T4 - Medium Hornbeam in the middle left of garden. This tree is blocking all the sun to the garden in the morning, which is the only time that they get sun because of the extra-largeTPO Horse chestnut tree in the middle of the garden. Remove this Hornbeam to groundlevel and poison the stump to allow the garden to be used as a garden rather than a forest.T5 - Medium male Holly tree in front garden. Reduce canopy by 20% in width and reduce height by up to 3m to make this tree smaller so that its more fitting for a front garden.
